'''Libyan Sign Language''' ({{Langx|ar|لغة الإشارة الليبية|translit=Lughat al-Ishārah al-Lībīyah}}) is the [[deaf sign language]] of [[Libya]]. It appears to belong to the [[Arab sign language family]] (Hendriks 2008).
